Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
an...@netcomuk.co.uk (stubby) wrote in
<3989af67...@nntp.netcomuk.co.uk>:

>seating order was Ian, James and Me

>its was james's turn. he took his minion actions -included bleeding
>me with lucien

All legit so far. Note that Lucien has bled during James' turn.

>end of his minion turn, i took a MN action to bleed ian

>james 2nd traditions with lucien but declined to block

First Wrong Bit. Second Tradition requires a block attempt.

>I bleed ian (much stealth)

>I asked james if he had ditched so i could have my uptap phase

>james said no and then tried to use the MN to bleed me with GTU with
>lucien

Second Wrong Bit. You can't use MN during your own turn. Cardtext states
'after ANOTHER Methuselah has finished all his or her minion phase
actions...' and James (the controller of MN) is not 'another' from
himself, no matter how many personalities he claims. Plus, if he's
declared himself to be finished with minion actions that minion phase, he
cannot take a MN action (which still takes part in the minion phase), by
the accepted definition of 'finished.'

Third Wrong Bit: Lucien has already bled this turn, so if you're using
NRA, that's not a legal action.

>I DI's his bleed card (as it was still his turn - i thought)

>He bleed me with another card, which I took
>
>he then ditched
>
>it was then my untap pahse.

>1) he couldn't have stayed untapped with 2nd trad as he didn't attempt
>to bloke

Correct.

>2) he couldn't have used the madness network as it was still the end
>of his minion phase (text on card starts end of others minion phase)

Correct.

>3) If he could have used the MN, I could have used the DI as it still
>wasn't my turn, but james.

Correct.

hope that helped,

gomi

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
stubby wrote:
>
> right. as three of us and a rules book still can't figure out what the
> replies were to the other post, i'm going to write it out step by step
> so people can make comments as to which bits were right or wrong
>

> seating order was Ian, James and Me
>
> its was james's turn. he took his minion actions -included bleeding
> me with lucien

"Lucian", the Malk Justicar, I presume.

> end of his minion turn, i took a MN action to bleed ian

"minion phase"

> james 2nd traditions with lucien but declined to block

Illegal. 2nd Tradition requires a block attempt. That attempt
will succeed unless the acting minion increases stealth beyond
the P/J's increased intercept (or otherwises denies the block,
as with Elder Impersonation). It would be illegal in this
case since james cannot even block the action directed at ian.

> I bleed ian (much stealth)
>

> I asked jame sif he had ditched so i could have my uptap phase

Don't know what you're saying there.

> james said no and then tried to use the MN to bleed me with GTU with
> lucien

Illegal. As the active Methuselah, he must have completed his minion
phase actions before any MN actions can be taken. Also, if you were
playing with the tournament NRA rules, Lucian cannot attempt a second
bleed action this turn.

> I DI's his bleed card (as it was still his turn - i thought)

Fair enough, although moot.

> He bleed me with another card, which I took
>
> he then ditched

Don't know what that means.

> it was then my untap pahse.
>

> after a fast think we decided he he couldn't have used the MN so it al
> reverted.
>
> i think the following
>

> 1) he couldn't have stayed untapped with 2nd trad as he didn't attempt
> to bloke

He couldn't have played 2nd tradition at all, since he cannot attempt to block.

> 2) he couldn't have used the madness network as it was still the end
> of his minion phase (text on card starts end of others minion phase)

Well, because card text says that the actions must occur after the (active)
"Methuselah has finished all of his or her minion phase actions".

> 3) If he could have used the MN, I could have used the DI as it still
> wasn't my turn, but james.

Right.
